questions.question: When some men brought a paralyzed man on a mat to Jesus, what did Jesus see before He spoke to the man?
When Jesus told a paralyzed man his sins were forgiven, what did some of the scribes say to themselves?

answers.text: This man must be a prophet
This man should heal him first

questions.question: Before healing a paralyzed man, Jesus said He wanted the scribes to know what about the Son of Man?

answers.text: He has authority on earth to forgive sins
He answers to the priests in Jerusalem
He speaks for the elders of His town

questions.question: When the crowds saw Jesus heal a paralyzed man who then got up and went home, how did they react?

answers.text: They were filled with awe and glorified God
They were afraid and begged Jesus to leave
They argued with the scribes about Jesus
